problem: Admin authority was binary (admin / non-admin) via system_configs.admin_users.value.openids — no roles, no least privilege, no audit trail, UI-only gating.

changes.AUTHORITY: admin_users collection becomes the single server-side authority (role/permissions/status). Legacy bootstrap ONLY while admin_users is empty (one-way explicit migration via adminMigrate); once any admin_users doc exists, legacy is ignored — no dual-track.
changes.LIB: cloudfunctions/<fn>/lib/adminAuth.js — ROLE_PERMISSIONS/ROLE_RANK/ALL_ROLES, resolveAdmin, hasPermission, canSeeRawOpenid, audit, countActiveSuperAdmins
changes.ENFORCEMENT: all admin* functions re-check permission server-side (dashboard:view users:view payments:view analytics:view content:manage config:manage users:manage users:detail)
changes.GUARDS: last-super-admin lockout BLOCK (disable + downgrade); self-downgrade when last super BLOCK
changes.AUDIT: admin_audit_logs { adminOpenid, action, targetType, targetId, before, after, timestamp }
changes.PRIVACY: masked OpenID default; raw OpenID only SUPER_ADMIN/OPERATOR (server-enforced)
changes.UI: pages/admin/admins — list + role管理 + audit log; canManage only for SUPER_ADMIN
